categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Cixing Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the knitting machinery industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent knitting machinery equipment, especially computerized flat knitting machines. The company also engages in automation equipment and project integration, as well as mobile internet traffic monetization businesses. Its main product lines include computerized knitting machines, simple knitting machines, shoe upper machines, and one-line forming computerized knitting machines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced computerized flat knitting technology integrating artificial intelligence, IoT, and big data to enhance automation, intelligence, and efficiency. It emphasizes smart manufacturing with remote monitoring and multifunctional knitting capabilities, including complex pattern and 3D structure production. Production is demand-driven, involving precise quality control of components sourced externally and in-house development of control systems, with comprehensive assembly, debugging, and quality inspection processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are enterprises producing knitwear products such as sweaters, scarves, hats, fly-knit shoes, and home decorations. The company serves a broad customer base exceeding ten thousand clients, including major brands and industry clusters in Guangdong Dongguan, Zhejiang Tongxiang, Shandong Haiyang, and Hebei Qinghe. The domestic market dominates sales, with a smaller portion exported mainly to Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant presence in Zhejiang, Guangdong, Shandong, Hebei, and Shanghai. It also has subsidiaries and sales activities in Hong Kong and exports to international markets, particularly Southeast Asia. The company has established research institutes and service centers across these key regions to support product development and customer service.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Cixing operates mainly in the midstream segment of the textile machinery supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of knitting machinery. It sources components from external suppliers but controls core technology development and final assembly. The company also provides after-sales services and technical support, integrating upstream raw materials and downstream customer needs through its ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on core technology breakthroughs and product iteration, especially in intelligent knitting machinery and one-line forming technology. It invests heavily in R&D, maintains domestic and international research teams, and collaborates with universities and research institutes. Strategic initiatives include digital transformation, 3D simulation design, expanding into smart wearable textiles, electronic skin, carbon fiber composites, and advanced medical textiles, aiming for large-scale commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of knitting machinery and automation equipment. The company employs a combined sales model of direct sales and sales consultants, with customers signing contracts directly. Additional revenue streams include mobile internet services such as online reading and e-commerce promotion, recognized at the point of service delivery. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Cixing is a leading player in China's computerized flat knitting machine industry, holding about 28% market share with significant sales growth. It is recognized as a standard-setting entity and innovator in the sector. The company competes with domestic and international knitting machinery manufacturers, leveraging its strong R&D, comprehensive product lines, and extensive service network to maintain a competitive edge amid industry consolidation and technological upgrades.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.22 billion, a 9.16% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 283.8 million, up 148.82%. Total assets stood at about RMB 4.97 billion, growing 3.65%, and net assets increased by 8.38% to RMB 3.20 billion. The company shows a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding sales volume, especially in its core knitting machinery segment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Cixing emphasizes its advanced intelligent knitting technology, comprehensive product range covering various needle gauges and functionalities, and strong innovation capabilities with numerous patents. The company offers integrated solutions including design, production, and after-sales services through a nationwide network of research institutes and service centers. Its focus on digital transformation, one-line forming technology, and customer-centric service creates a differentiated value proposition that enhances production efficiency, product quality, and customization capabilities for clients.
